subject.title: feat: show cloud workspace conflicts in the Control UI

question: Should this maintainer-labeled cloud-worker UI phase wait for successful exact-head real conflict proof, or may maintainers explicitly accept mock/browser proof as sufficient for this UI-only phase?
rationale: The contributor reports that all available worker backends failed before creating a lease, so automation cannot establish the missing real cloud-worker boundary without a maintainer decision or working provider access.

options.title: Require real conflict proof
options.body: Keep the PR pending until a real cloud-worker turn produces a conflict and shows the recovery UI and durable history on the exact head.

options.title: Accept scoped UI proof
options.body: Explicitly accept the existing mocked Gateway/browser lifecycle proof as adequate for this presentation-only phase after a manual source review.

recommendation.title: Require real conflict proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR pending until a real cloud-worker turn produces a conflict and shows the recovery UI and durable history on the exact head.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied merged-history context connects this person to all three cloud-workspace recovery phases and the current UI implementation.
